Registry tren man hep (< 640px): bang bon cot thanh the xep chong (truong, gia tri, cap nguon + nguon), sua 166 doan chu bi cat ma phep do tran khung moi bat o 390px; can do lai tren may that.

Soi anh that va sua 3 loi hien thi, moi loi mot cong co rang: (1) dong thoi gian ho so de nhan (FPT, VNPT, NCS, 1Matrix): bo tri tach ra lib/dong-thoi-gian.mjs xep nhan theo hop bao, cong dong_thoi_gian do hinh hoc doc lap (NHAN_CHONG, NHAN_DE_CHAM, NHAN_TRAN, NHAN_AN_NHIEU, THIEU_DIEM) + 6 rang, cach cu bi cong bat 4 vu; (2) cau nguon hien dau markdown (**MiSmart**, [FPT](url)): lib/hien-cau.mjs chi go dau dinh dang, ban goc giu nguyen cho ma kiem toan, cong hien_cau (CON_DAU, MAT_CHU, CAU_THO) + 5 rang; (3) Bao cao 390px bi cat mep phai: luoi trang minmax(0,1fr), kiem-truy-cap do them TRAN KHUNG tung doan chu o 1440 va 390 kem tu kiem thuoc do tren mau dung san, check-truy-cap them TRAN_KHUNG, THIEU_DO_TRAN, THUOC_DO_HONG + 3 rang.
